title: Let’s sync your followers.
lead: This first sync is the baseline. Then xGhost compares regularly and tells you about every unfollow. Your data stays on this computer; export it from the settings to back it up.

session.readingHandle: Your X account is connected. Your @ will show after the sync.
session.loginThenBack: Log in to X, then come back here.

scan.title: Syncing your followers
scan.done_one: Baseline of {{n}} follower saved. Taking you to your dashboard…
scan.done_other: Baseline of {{n}} followers saved. Taking you to your dashboard…
scan.incomplete: Incomplete sync ({{pct}}): the x.com tab was closed or the list stopped too early. Followers already fetched are kept.

frequency.title: How often should we check?
frequency.hint: The more often, the sooner you know. You can change it later.

keepBrowsing: You can keep using Chrome normally during the sync.

choice.title: How do you want to start?
choice.syncText: xGhost fetches your followers on X. About 3 min.
choice.restoreText: Used xGhost before? Import your .json file, without going through X again.

limit.title: xGhost can’t handle that many followers yet.
limit.alertText: xGhost supports up to {{limit}} followers per account. Beyond that, syncing would take too long and could hit X’s limits. No sync will be started.
limit.otherAccount: Have another X account with fewer than {{limit}} followers? Log in to it on x.com, xGhost will pick it up automatically.
